title: Hard Cases, Bad Labels: Testing Error Exposure and Error Location in Uncertainty Sampling Under Bounded Label Noise
abstract: arXiv:2608.13601v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Active learning can reduce labeling cost by selecting informative examples, but the most uncertain examples may also be the hardest to label correctly. This study tests whether uncertainty sampling fails because it acquires more corrupted labels or because errors concentrated in difficult regions are especially harmful. Margin-based uncertainty sampling is compared with random sampling under clean labels, random classification noise (RCN), and bounded difficulty-dependent noise on three public binary tabular datasets. The design uses 100 paired seeds, nine expected noise rates from 0 to 0.30, annotation budgets from 20 to 120, and logistic regression with regularization re-selected by cross-validation at every budget. An exposure-matched RCN control aligns mean final acquired corruption, while a clean-label extension reaches budget 400. translated_title: 困难案例，糟糕标签：在有界标签噪声下不确定性采样中的错误暴露与错误位置测试
translated_abstract: 主动学习可以通过选择信息量大的样本来降低标注成本，但最不确定的样本也可能是最难正确标注的。本研究测试了不确定性采样失败的原因，是因为它获取了更多被污染的标签，还是因为集中在困难区域的错误特别有害。在三个公开的二值表格数据集上，将基于边际的不确定性采样与随机采样在干净标签、随机分类噪声（RCN）和有界难度依赖噪声下进行了比较。实验设计使用了100对配对种子、从0到0.30的九个预期噪声率、从20到120的标注预算，以及在每个预算下通过交叉验证重新选择正则化的逻辑回归。一个暴露匹配的RCN对照使最终平均获取的污染程度对齐，而一个干净标签扩展达到了预算400。在干净标签下，不确定性采样提高了归一化平衡准确率下的学习曲线面积。
tldr: 本研究通过对照实验发现，不确定性采样在标签噪声下的失败主要源于困难区域中错误位置的集中影响，而非单纯错误暴露数量的增加。
en_tdlr: This study reveals through controlled experiments that the failure of uncertainty sampling under label noise primarily stems from the concentrated impact of errors in difficult regions, rather than merely the increased exposure to corrupted labels.
